item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00221","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C09","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 supplies unmistakably concrete drafting material for the child. Its Part VII delegates section 708 voluntary-agreement functions and imposes the same two distinctive procedural conditions: consultation with the Attorney General and FTC Chairman at least ten days before a section 708(b) request or finding, and Attorney General approval before making a request. The child reproduces those conditions nearly verbatim while adapting the delegate and scope to small-business production pools. Its redelegation clause also closely tracks C12's general machinery allowing redelegation and successive redelegation to government agencies and officers.
